en.name: Destiny Draw: Friendship and Bonds
en.effect:
You can only use this Skill's first and second effects once per Duel.
1: Can be used before your normal draw. Your normal draw this turn will be a "Marincess" monster from your Deck.
2: Reveal 1 "Marincess" card in your hand and either place it on the bottom of your Deck or send it to the Graveyard. Then, draw 2 cards.

releases.description: Summon "Marincess Great Bubble Reef" 3 time(s) while playing as Blue Maiden and Aqua.
